# Web3Law Stablecoin Policy Reports

Machine-readable regulatory analysis reports on global stablecoin policy.

## API

- List reports (free): https://stablecoin-policy.vercel.app/api/reports
- Full content (paid via x402): https://stablecoin-policy.vercel.app/api/reports/[slug]

## Payment

- Protocol: x402
- Network: Base Sepolia (eip155:84532) [testnet]
- Currency: USDC
- Pricing: $0.01 per report (testnet validation pricing - production pricing TBD)

## Skill

See: https://stablecoin-policy.vercel.app/.well-known/x402-skill.md
